scope: 30 named identities, all eight facings and future authored action frames

coordinate_contract.reference_pose: neutral grounded S, same construction camera as other views
coordinate_contract.height_definition: support sole plane to anatomical skull crown; exclude hair volume, horns, crown, fins, wings, raised hands and back appendages
coordinate_contract.width_definition: anatomical left-right span in frontal construction pose, excluding hands, armor overhang, weapons, cape, tail, wings and ears
coordinate_contract.depth_definition: anatomical front-back chest thickness in profile construction pose, excluding cape and back attachments
not_allowed: changing gameplay hurtboxes to match costume
measuring skull height from beard or hair outline

head_contract.measurement: annotated neutral frontal anatomical crown to chin; excludes hair, ears, horns, crown, beard and foliage
head_contract.width_policy: preserve annotated anatomical aspect ratio with isotropic head scale; width varies by race identity, not size class
head_contract.registration: one fixed head-group scale per identity, reused across all views/actions, anchored at each view's neck; body group separately calibrated
head_contract.construction: retain 58/63/68 total anatomical height; 2px neck; remaining torso/leg length split 5:7 after subtracting reviewed skull target
not_allowed: derive skull bounds from opaque or core-body bbox
multiply absolute head scale by body scale a second time
uniformly resize complete actor to repair new head height
head_contract.integration_gate: complete jaw/head mask and reviewed neck registration before applying fixed head scale; current head cut can leave jaw on torso
head_contract.historical_assets: prior fullbody-v2 and authored-keys-v1 scales remain historical registration receipts, not proof of shared-skull conformance

profile_notes: Ratios are target guides, not measurements of approved art; volume index is a relative art-direction objective, not physical density or a mesh-volume assertion.
Skull, neck, torso and leg ratios describe a neutral vertical construction silhouette; dynamic poses rotate these segments and must not be resized back to standing height.
Width and depth are authored before camera projection; genuine profile and quarter-view differences are required.
Female, male and unspecified presentation do not change the size profile, gameplay stats or rig bone lengths.
Identity-specific dwarven compactness, plant forms, snouts and stone plates may vary within explicit tolerances; do not turn all races into identical humans.

annotation_requirements.annotation_state: 30 frontal core estimates and three eight-view joint pilots recorded; other27 directional joints heuristic; explicit skull bounds and complete head masks need separate reviewed calibration
annotation_requirements.calibration: fixed body calibration plus size-independent isotropic head calibration per identity, both reused across every view and motion frame; head registered at neck, never whole-frame bbox fit
annotation_requirements.unknown_landmarks: flag for manual/source correction; do not silently derive from opaque bounds

acceptance.appendage_clearance_policy: retain at least one transparent pixel; correct source arrangement or flag overflow, never shrink anatomy until horns or wings fit
acceptance.directional_policy: 45-degree authored views with front/rear and left/right unambiguous; facial features absent from N and rear quarters unless physically justified by anatomy
acceptance.motion_policy: size follows anatomy and bone lengths, not current silhouette height; slide/roll compress through pose, not rescale; running alternates contact legs
